name: u-maker
description: PBGD-based SSoT plugin for Claude Code. 4-phase pipeline (Plan/Build/Gatekeeping/Deploy), 10 agents, 24 skills (/u-prepare umbrella, /u-analyze, /u-figma analyzer, /u-build orchestrator, /u-gatekeeping, /u-deploy with interactive target + artifact selection, plus /u-createproject, /u-output, /u-reverse, /u-meeting-report and backward-compat aliases /u-init, /u-check, /u-qa). 11-criteria quality gate (pass ≥95, deploy-gate ≥98), continuous deploy regeneration, domain-split HTML output.
